questions.stem: A 24-year female presenting with muscle weakness is being evaluated for Myasthenia gravis. Which of the following is NOT true about it?

options.label: A
options.text: Anti-AChR antibodies are detectable in the serum of ~85% of all myasthenic patients:

options.label: B
options.text: The presence of anti-AChR antibodies is virtually diagnostic of MG

options.label: C
options.text: A negative test of anti-AChR antibodies doesn’t exclude the disease

options.label: D
options.text: The measured level of anti-AChR antibody corresponds well with the severity of MG
